kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننسلخ (form VII)
# نَنْسَلِخُ (nansaliḵu) /nan.sa.li.xu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْسَلَخَ (insalaḵa)
# نَنْسَلِخَ (nansaliḵa) /nan.sa.li.xa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَلَخَ (insalaḵa)
# نَنْسَلِخْ (nansaliḵ) /nan.sa.lix/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْسَلَخَ (insalaḵa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
